mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quizzes (id, quiz_title, time_limit_minutes, pass_score, ai_settings_id, course_id, student_id, teacher_id, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{quizTitle}, #{timeLimitMinutes}, #{passScore}, NULL, #{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{teacherId}, #{active}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE quizzes SET quiz_title = #{quizTitle}, time_limit_minutes = #{timeLimitMinutes}, pass_score = #{passScore}, course_id = #{courseId}, student_id = #{studentId}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, active = #{active}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, quiz_title, time_limit_minutes, pass_score, course_id, student_id, teacher_id, active, created_at, updated_at FROM quizzes WHERE course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
